arrival.text: Huh. I guess the fuse went out again.

recording.text: Mara? It's Mum. The fuse went out again. There are spares in the kitchen. Please don't leave before saying goodnight.

power.text: They disconnected this house on Monday.

repeat.text: I straightened that photograph before I left.

returned.text: You always look away before the difficult part.

key.text: Her bedroom. I haven't opened it since they took her away.

diary.text: The kitchen radio. Then her bath. Then the music box. I thought the silence would wake her.

time.text: The mirror has three seventeen written on it.

call.text: Mara. Listen to what you keep calling the last night. The music box was still playing. Your hand was on the lid. You closed it before you called anyone. Put her things back. Then stop the sounds. Don't change the order again.

inverted.text: This is the room I keep turning away from.

command.text: You keep putting yourself on the wrong side.

released.text: It's quiet. That doesn't make it finished.

unlocked.text: Now tell it the right way round.

ending.text: You were looking right at me.

broadcast.text: Rain overnight. All roads out of the valley remain closed. Another bulletin will follow.

letter.text: Personal effects. That's what they called them when they sent her home.

watch.text: They gave this back in a sealed bag. It's warm.

ring.text: She wore this for forty-three years. It used to catch on my hair.

ribbon.text: I tied the lid open. She hated when the music stopped.

ritual.text: There. Every little thing put back. That's how you told it.

empty.text: I kept leaving myself out of it.

farewell.text: It wasn't the illness. I stabbed you in the bathroom. You ran to your bed. I followed you. I kept going. I killed you, Mum.

sob.text: No... no. Mum. I'm sorry. I'm so sorry.

news.text: Police have confirmed that sixty-eight-year-old Evelyn Vale was attacked in her bathroom and died in her bedroom. Her daughter, Mara Vale, who had been her full-time carer for seven years, has admitted repeatedly stabbing her mother. Detectives say Mara called for an ambulance from the house at three seventeen in the morning. The death was not caused by her illness.

photoMemory.text: Dad was still alive. Everything was simpler then. Mum never stopped missing him.

crimeBathroom.text: It started here. She tried to get away from me.

crimeTrail.text: She held the wall. All the way to her room.

crimeKitchen.text: I took it from here. I brought it to her.
